title: Due Any Day! Jania Meshell Has Fans Sending Heartfelt Messages Following Her Sweet Pregnancy Update (PHOTOS) - NewsBreak
text:
By Ashley Rushford ,
4 hours ago Aww, Roomies! It looks like Jania Meshell and Dejounte Murray could welcome their baby boy any day now! Jania recently hopped on social media to share a sweet pregnancy update, seemingly hinting that she’s getting ready for her little one’s BIG arrival!
RELATED: Pop Out Then! Jania Meshell Shares Maternity Shoot Photos With Dejounte Murray As Fans React With Mixed Feelings Jania Meshell Seemingly Gives Sweet Update On Her Baby Boy Meshell recently hopped on Instagram and dropped some new photos, giving fans a lil’ update as she prepares to welcome her baby boy and second child with Dejounte Murray. Jania stepped out in a fire fall fit, rocking a burgundy jacket that featured artwork of Dejounte on the front. She paired the jacket with black leggings and knee-high boots, serving a whole look as per usual! Jania kept her baby bump covered, but she made it clear that her little prince could arrive any day now! She let fans know she’s still slaying while waiitng for her baby boy to make his grand entrance, writing, “Due any day, still serving💅🏾”
Fans Send Love As Jania Prepares To Welcome Her Mini-Me Jania’s caption had fans flooding her comment section with love and heartfelt messages. Plenty of folks sent prayers for a smooth and safe delivery, while others gave her flowers for carrying her pregnancy and serving looks the entire time.
Instagram user @ lovecilla____ wrote, “ Awww omg even your fingers are swollen😭😭😭have a safe delivery boo we love you!!”
Instagram user @ justgenvieve wrote, “ You look so pretty and you always carry so beautifully 😍 wishing you a safe + healthy delivery for mom and baby Nene!”
While Instagram user @ jorriaaa wrote, “ 😍😍badddd tinggg.”
Then Instagram user @ tiah_b28 wrote, “ Still the badddest pregnant an all!❤️❤️❤️🤏🏾”
Another Instagram user @ lorrainearthur91 wrote, “ Safe delivery and congratulations 🎈”
Instagram user @ qyeence_ wrote, “ Ignore the negativity cause pregnancy and all you’re killing it ❤️😮‍💨”
Then another Instagram user @ iamardri wrote, “ you be carrying them kids so damn well, i thought you had the baby already 😭😍😍”
Finally, Instagram user @ados.eofbania wrote, “ Face card 😍”
Jania Meshell Serves & Slays In Maternity Photos Jania has continued to keep fans in the loop about her pregnancy on Instagram. Recently, she gave them a peek at her maternity photos, and chileeee, she ATE DOWN! Fans couldn’t stop giving her 10s across the board after she dropped a series of photos showing her posing alongside Dejounte in a sheer black dress that put her growing baby bump on full display. Jania didn’t just serve looks! She also shared a sweet message for her baby boy letting him know just how deeply he’s loved writing, “You will never have to wonder how deeply you are loved, my son. It started long before your first breath 💙”
